{{Top}}
'''Botajef Shipyards''' was the manufacturer of the [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]] and the [[SS-54 assault ship/Legends|SS-54 light freighter]]. They had construction and testing facilities located throughout the entire southern continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]]. Huge 325-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] elevator cables stretched from the surface of the world to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] yards.
